description_en: Queries the servers on which the same risk item is detected by specifying a baseline and a check item
description_zh: 指定基线和检查项，查询存在相同风险的服务器列表
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-check-warning-machines --risk-id 43 --check-id 58 --status 1 --lang zh --resource-directory-account-id 12324284232340000 --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --remark 1.2.XX.XX --instance-id cri-rv4nvbv8iju40000 --filter-uuid 2f64e1a0f9316c480000000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCheckWarningMachines

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the baseline.

You can call the [DescribeCheckWarningSummary](~~DescribeCheckWarningSummary~~) operation to query the IDs of baselines
parameters.help_zh:
基线的ID。

您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116179.html接口获取基线ID
parameters.name: risk_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the check item.

You can call the [DescribeCheckWarningSummary](~~DescribeCheckWarningSummary~~) operation to query the IDs of check items
parameters.help_zh:
检查项的ID。
您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116179.html接口获取检查项ID
parameters.name: check_id

parameters.help_en:
The risk status of the check item. Valid values:

1: failed
3: passed
parameters.help_zh:
检查项风险状态。取值：
1：未通过
3：已通过
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认值为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member in the resource directory.

You can call the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain the IDs
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号主账号ID。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，显示的当前页的页码
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，显示的每页数据的最大条数
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The information about the server that you want to query. The value can be the name or the public IP address of the server
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的资产信息，可以设置为资产名称、公网IP
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the asset
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的服务器实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the asset that you don't want to query
parameters.help_zh: 查询需要排除的服务器UUID
parameters.name: filter_uuid
